svg.title: Hamrah Arc 58 physical layout
svg.desc: Mirrored split layout with 56 Kailh Choc v1 (PG1350) switches and two clickable encoders. All dimensions are millimetres.
svg.text: 6×4 + clickable encoder + four-key descending thumb arc · Choc v1 · 19.05 × 19.05 mm Sofle pitch
T1 is 1 mm outward from C5 / C6 midpoint
